title: Dailybot | Workflow updates, multi-org switch & more - What we've been cooking · Changelog
summary: From smart conditions in your workflows to better context switching between chat spaces to better reporting UX and more.
body_markdown: We’ve been cooking up a host of improvements. Smart conditions in your workflows give you more control over when and how check-ins run. Better context switching between chat spaces makes it easier to manage multiple teams. Improved reporting UX helps you get insights faster. And there’s more under the hood to make Dailybot smoother and more reliable.
